title.narrative: Output 8.1. Increased capacity of Member States to develop new or reformed sustainable national social protection strategies, policies or legal frameworks to extend coverage and enhance benefit adequacy

description.narrative: On 24 November 2023, the Government adopted Resolution No. 42 on “Continue to reform the social policies in the new period” regarding Social Policy Development for 2023-2030 with a vision to 2045. This Resolution provides strategic directions for building a comprehensive social policies framework toward expanding social protection coverage to ensure universal coverage which leaves no one behind. The Resolution also aims at increasing integration between social security branches, as well as between SP and employment policies. The Resolution will act as the Framework for reforming social policies in Viet Nam in the next 10 years. The Resolution has been widely consulted with all related stakeholders and social partners. In January 2023, the Government completed the Review of 10 year of implementation of Resolution 15-NQ/TW on Social Policies 2012-2022. ILO developed 3 reports to support the review of the Resolution. The reports provided evidence-based knowledge to promote a multi-tiered social protection system, using a life-cycle approach, towards a social protection floor, with a focus on expanding protection to informal economy workers, women, children, and other vulnerable groups. ILO provided support for 4 national high-level consultation workshops to facilitate the policy dialogue on the review of the Resolution and policy options for reforming the social security system under the new Resolution.
